The Claude Agent SDK enables you to programmatically build AI agents with Claude Code's capabilities. Create autonomous agents that can understand codebases, edit files, run commands, and execute complex workflows.

**Learn more in the [official documentation](https://docs.claude.com/en/api/agent-sdk/overview)**.

## Get started

Install the Claude Agent SDK:

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk
```

## Migrating from the Claude Code SDK

The Claude Code SDK is now the Claude Agent SDK. Please check out the [migration guide](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/sdk/migration-guide) for details on breaking changes.

## Reporting Bugs

We welcome your feedback. File a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/issues) to report bugs or request features.

## Connect on Discord

Join the [Claude Developers Discord](https://anthropic.com/discord) to connect with other developers building with the Claude Agent SDK. Get help, share feedback, and discuss your projects with the community.

## Data collection, usage, and retention

When you use the Claude Agent SDK, we collect feedback, which includes usage data (such as code acceptance or rejections), associated conversation data, and user feedback submitted via the /bug command.

### How we use your data

See our [data usage policies](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/data-usage).

### Privacy safeguards

We have implemented several safeguards to protect your data, including limited retention periods for sensitive information, restricted access to user session data, and clear policies against using feedback for model training.

*** Add File: README.md
+## Claude Agent SDK Playground
+
+Hands-on examples that mirror what the Claude Code CLI can do while showing the additional control you get from the [Claude Agent SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript).
+
+### Prerequisites
+
+1. Node.js 18.18+ (same runtime requirement as the official CLI).
+2. An Anthropic API key exposed as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
+3. Optional: set `CLAUDE_AGENT_WORKDIR` if you want the agent to work on a different directory than this repo.
+
+Quick setup:
+
+```bash
+cp .env.example .env          # edit with your API key
+npm install
+```
+
+### Demos
+
+| Script | Command | Purpose |
+| ------ | ------- | ------- |
+| `src/basicAgent.ts` | `npm run chat -- "prompt here"` | Single-turn run that streams all SDK messages so you can see the low-level protocol. Mirrors `claude workon --prompt "..."`
+| `src/multiTurnRepl.ts` | `npm run repl` | An interactive REPL that feeds user messages into `query()` on demand. This replicates the Claude Code CLI TUI loop but lets you embed it anywhere. |
+| `src/toolsAndHooksAgent.ts` | `npm run tools -- "prompt"` | Demonstrates custom MCP tools + hook callbacks that run in your own process—functionality you cannot inject into the stock CLI. |
+
+Each script shares the same console renderer so you can compare what the SDK is emitting with what the CLI usually hides.
+
+### Same vs. different from the Claude Code CLI
+
+| Capability | Agent SDK | CLI |
+| ---------- | --------- | --- |
+| Streaming transcript, partial deltas | ✅ (see `ConsoleRenderer` output) | ✅ |
+| Built-in permission prompts & plan mode | ✅ (`permissionMode` option) | ✅ |
+| Supply your own MCP servers (same process) | ✅ `createSdkMcpServer(...)` | ⚠️ CLI can only launch subprocess servers |
+| Inline hook callbacks for tool usage, notifications, etc. | ✅ `hooks: { PreToolUse: [...] }` | ⚠️ Requires plugin authoring |
+| Programmatic control over cwd, env, thinking tokens | ✅ pass via `Options` | ⚠️ limited flags |
+| Ready-made UX | ➖ you build it | ✅ full-screen TUI |
+
+### What to look at
+
+- `src/lib/consoleRenderer.ts` – decodes every `SDKMessage` so you can see initialization events, tool calls, hook output, and final usage breakdowns.
+- `src/lib/runAgent.ts` – thin wrapper around `query()` that ensures the same defaults as the CLI (cwd, env loading, error handling).
+- `src/toolsAndHooksAgent.ts` – registers a local MCP server with three tools plus hook callbacks that log when tools run; this showcases a workflow that’s identical in behavior to the CLI but customizable without writing a Claude plugin.
+
+### Tips
+
+- Pass `CLAUDE_AGENT_WORKDIR=/path/to/your/app` when you want Claude to edit something outside of this repo.
+- The REPL understands the pseudo-commands `:exit`, `:help`, and `:clear`, mirroring the ergonomics of the CLI while keeping the session in your terminal.
+- Because everything runs through the SDK you can embed the same helpers inside tests, scripts, or a long-running service—no need to shell out to the CLI.
*** End Patch
